content.text: The insurance clause meets every element of the preferred position.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: § 18 contains a full vendor insurance clause that meets the preferred position on every material term: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O at USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability at USD 5M, and workers' compensation as required by law, each maintained at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year. § 18.2 adds certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, reputable insurers, primary cover, notice of cancellation, and confirms that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. Employer's liability of USD 1M is additional cover beyond the playbook ask and benefits us. No redline required.
